item.description: Yusuf Aziz analysis: Technology imposes need — where there is a device, there is measurement; where there is no device, there is estimation. 24 field verdicts, surgical specialist field voice (S11), 6 blind AI voices, and 90+ verified DOI/PubMed sources.

item.title: Face to Tooth: How a QLoRA Model Trained on 3D Cephalometry Beat the Untrained Model
item.description: Atlas Studio experiment: The untrained model reads a square jaw as 'oval' and picks a rounded feminine line. 478-landmark 3D cephalometry + 1,000-iteration MLX QLoRA: face-shape accuracy 0% → 90.6%, target line 0% → 100% (n=32 locked test); live 3D module on a 100% synthetic face.
